verdict.rationale: Intel's ARK specifications page for the 258V is confirmed as a real, keyless-fetchable spec sheet listing cores, clocks, power, and memory support, satisfying the core of the story; the rest of the evidence pack is largely marketing copy with no explicit AI TOPS figures or documented test conditions cited. Missing for 10: direct citation of AI TOPS numbers with stated test methodology/conditions, and independent corroboration of ARK spec accuracy.
